Cap.5: Overworld Boss:
Hive Core
The Hive Core
Entity:
mycelialmind:hive_core
350 HP | 14 Dmg | 10
Arm | 350 XP
`hive_altar`. P1: 3-acid
fan. P2 (65–30%):
invulnerable via 3
`sentinel_node`.

Phase 3 & Hive Core
Loot
• Phase 2 Anchors:
shatter all 3 tethered
`sentinel_node`s to
break its shield and
stun it.
• Phase 3 (<30% HP) &
Loot: cycles Tier 2
synergies +
shockwaves. Drops:
`hive_heart`,
`synaptic_core`,
`neural_echo_core`,
`synaptic_graft`.

arch

Arm | 750 XP

barrage + blink. P2

Cap.6: The 4 Synaptic
Node Types
Synaptic Node
Typology (1/3)
• `RELAY`
(`mycelial_node`): links
hubs within
`synapticNodeLinkRadiu
s` (28m), amplifies
local stimulus x1.5,
and holds 60/40
buffers (`600t`).

Synaptic Node
Typology (2/3)
• `INCUBATOR`
(`incubator_node`):
hatches combat
squads and
`spore_architect`;
global cap
`maxAutonomousNodes
= 32` with
`minNodeSpacing =
18m`.

Synaptic Node
Typology (3/3)
• `SENTINEL`
(`sentinel_node`):
shields nearby
swarmers and
anchors Phase 2
invulnerability for
`hive_core` and
`apex_matriarch`.
• `SYMBIOTIC`
(`symbiotic_node`, BE
`synaptic_node`):
reprogrammed allied

hub for acoustic
silencing and fast
travel.

Cap.6: Synaptic Graft
& Fast Travel
Hijacking with Synaptic
Graft
Item:
mycelialmind:synaptic_g
raft
Apply `synaptic_graft`
to a hostile node ->
`symbiotic_node` (cap
`maxSymbioticNodes =
4`). Recharge +15%
using
`mycelial_biomass`.

Mycorrhizal Fast
Travel (1/2)
• Link (`Shift +
Right-Click`): warps
between
`symbiotic_node`s
within 96m
(`mycorrhizalTravelRa
nge`, `16–256m`).
• Cost & Locks: 6
food, 15 stability,
`240t`
`mycelial_infection`,
`60t` Nausea (`1500t`

CD); blocked if hurt
`<100t` or infected.

Mycorrhizal Fast
Travel (2/2)
• Escort Transfer:
teleports owned
`FOLLOW`/ridden
Chimeras and
non-patrol Drones
within 12m right
alongside you.

ho_decoy

pings Nodes (`32m`)

Item:

esearch_bench
`Shift + Click`: T1->T2
(`synaptic_core`, 25%
biomass save); T2->T3
(`neural_echo_core`/`
overmind_essence`,
50% save + 2x
serums).

• `symbiotic_mutagen`:
`GeneticSample`
(typed) +
`MycelialBiomass` +
`SynapticCore`.
• `counter_serum`:
`GeneticSample`
(typed) +
`LatentSpore` +
(`PurifierGrenade` or
Amethyst) -> 1x (2x

Syntheses (2/2)
•
`concentrated_antidot
e`: `SporeAntidote` +
`LatentSpore` +

`GeneticSample` +

ndler`

Cap.7: Symbiosis & The
5 Mutagens
The 5 Symbiotic
Mutagens (1/4)
• Rules (`symbiosis`):
max `maxMutagenSlots
= 2`, adds +15%
Threat/slot (`1.0 +
0.15*n`), inflicts
`mycelial_infection`
(`120t`) every `60t` on
bare mycelium, and
clears upon death.

The 5 Symbiotic
Mutagens (2/4)
• `CHITIN_THORNS`
(`chitin_thorns`,
`MELEE`): +2.0 Armor
and reflects 25%
melee damage back as
thorns (min `1.0F`).
• `KINETIC_STRAFE`
(`kinetic_strafe`,
`PROJECTILE`): 30%
chance to dodge
projectiles completely

and burst Speed I
(`60t`).

The 5 Symbiotic
Mutagens (3/4)
• `PYRO_GLAND`
(`pyro_gland`, `FIRE`):
full fire immunity
(cancels `IS_FIRE` &
douses flames) +
melee strikes ignite
attackers for `3s`.

The 5 Symbiotic
Mutagens (4/4)
• `BLAST_CARAPACE`
(`blast_carapace`,
`EXPLOSION`): +0.5 KB
Res. and cuts blast
damage to 55% (-45%).
• `ARCANE_SYNAPSE`
(`arcane_synapse`,
`MAGIC`): permanent
Night Vision and magic
damage reduced to
60% (-40%).

Cap.7: Strain Schisms &
Diplomacy
Strain Civil War
Item:
mycelialmind:schism_inj
ector
Inject a node/mob
with `schism_injector`:
`ORTHODOX` (#9B4DFF,
-100) vs `AMBER`
(#F2A93B) vs
`CRIMSON` (#E03C5C)
fight on sight.

Standing, Tribute &
Betrayal (1/2)
• Ranks (`Standing`,
`-100..+100`):
`HOSTILE` `<=-40`,
`NEUTRAL` `-39..24`,
`PACT` `>=+25` (`BASE`
ignores `>4.5m`),
`ALLIED` `>=+60`
(`BASE` & `MUTATED`).
Positive rep applies
`-0.5x` to rival strain.

Standing, Tribute &
Betrayal (2/2)
• Tools & Limits:
`ELITE` and Bosses
never respect pacts.
Betrayal triggers -35
rep and 30s (`600t`)
lockout.
`truce_pheromone`
pacifies temporarily;
`quorum_seal` tributes
4 biomass (+12 rep) /
max 2 escorts (45s).

Armor
Stats of `chitin`
Material
Item:
mycelialmind:chitin_che
stplate
Armor `[2, 5, 6, 2]`
(Body 9), Ench 14,
Tough 1.0F, repaired
with `chitin_plate`. Cuts
infection duration
-20% per piece.

Evolution &
`DataComponents`
(1/2)
• `armor_rank` (`BASE`
-> `MUTATED` ->
`ELITE`): upgrade to
`MUTATED` with
`synaptic_core`
(self-repairs on
mycelium/Tide) and to
`ELITE` with
`overmind_essence` or
`tide_beacon`.

Evolution &
`DataComponents`
(2/2)
• Elite Reflect &
`trait_id`: `ELITE`
grants Absorption &
reflects `1.25 *
pieces` magic dmg;
`trait_id` stores
elemental affinity on
armor,
`genetic_sample`, and
serums.

Cap.8: The 4 Endgame
Relics
Overmind Crown
Item:
mycelialmind:overmind_
crown
• In mid-air: purges
15.0% Global Threat
(1200t / 60s
cooldown).
• On
`purification_pylon`:
overcharges and
cleanses a 12m radius

Beacon, Suppressor &
Catalyst (1/2)
• `tide_beacon`:
dispels an active
Fungal Tide;
rechargeable via
amethyst and chitin
(`tide_beacon_rechar
ge`).
•
`synaptic_suppressor`
: locks global Hive
adaptation (`120s` CD).

Beacon, Suppressor &
Catalyst (2/2)
• `rift_catalyst`:
ignites a `mycelial_rift`
portal inside a valid
`reinforced_bio_barri
er` frame toward Deep
Mycelium
(`deep_mycelium`).

Cap.8: Bastion Defense
& Turrets
Bastion Defense
Engineering (1/2)
• `purification_pylon`
(`monument_focus`):
blocks mycelium (`24m`
default,
`pylonPurificationRadiu
s`), cures infection,
blocks carrion, and
smothers if >=4
`antibody_cyst` cover

its faces in Deep
Mycelium.

Bastion Defense
Engineering (2/2)
• `purification_turret`
(Tiers 1–3):
auto-fires
neutralizing spores;
repairable with
Antidote, Chitin, or
Iron (cleanse if
jammed 120t).
•
`purifier_drone_core`
deploys Drones;
`reinforced_bio_barri
er` fortifies walls.
